notes.title: End of Open Alpha Test
notes.notes:
Hello, Survivors from around the world!

It seems like I’ve been writing a lot of letters to you all today!

The Open Alpha Test, which left both excitement and frustration, has come to an end.

From the third day of testing, both the development team and survivors from around the world faced a series of intense challenges together.

Players who set aside time to play with their friends, streamers who prepared broadcasts for their viewers, players who waited patiently for maintenance to end, and those who spent their time staring endlessly at that cursed red circle on the loading screen…

You must be tired of hearing apologies, but I want to say it again—I truly feel a deep sense of responsibility, and we are already preparing for what comes next.

As I mentioned before, we have clearly identified the key areas for improvement, and we will take a short period to regroup and immediately begin structural reworks. Over the next three months, we will devote all our efforts to refining the game's structure, improving its stability, and making it an even more enjoyable experience when we return.

We also plan to expand our development team, and starting next week, new developers will be joining us.

As I will be focusing more on leading the development team, I may not be able to appear as often as I have been. However, I will do my best to stay engaged, communicate with you frequently, and share updates on the roadmap.

During this playtest, we received a lot of criticism but also a lot of support. We will take all of it as fuel to keep pushing forward, ensuring that this game solidifies its place as a Top Tier Extraction Game!

On behalf of the entire development team, I sincerely thank each and every one of you who participated in this 5day Open Alpha Playtest.

Wishing you all a great weekend!

Director Ray

notes.title: Announcement: Early Termination of Open Alpha Playtest
notes.notes:
Hello, Survivors from around the world,
This is Ray, the Director of The Midnight Walkers.

We have made the difficult decision to end the Open Alpha Playtest earlier than scheduled, concluding it on [b]Fri, 28 Feb 2025 21:00(UTC)[/b] instead of the originally planned Sat, 1 Mar 2025 14:59(UTC). I sincerely apologize for closing the test earlier than expected.

During this test, we discovered unexpected structural flaws on the server-side, which led to abnormal session occupancy caused by certain attack methods and bots, ultimately forcing dedicated servers to shut down unexpectedly.

Fortunately, we have clearly identified the root causes and solutions for these issues. However, we have concluded that at least two weeks of improvement work is required to fully resolve the fundamental problems.

We acknowledge that, in our pursuit of rapid development, some areas were insufficiently robust, which resulted in vulnerabilities. As the Director, I take full responsibility for this and have decided that the best course of action is to terminate the playtest early and immediately begin structural improvements to ensure a more stable environment. Maintaining the scheduled test period under these circumstances would have only led to frustration and disappointment for both players and the development team.
That said, we were incredibly moved by the unexpectedly high level of interest and participation in this playtest. Thanks to your involvement, we were able to clearly identify potential issues within the game, and we now have a much clearer direction for solving them. The problems we face are not insurmountable, but simply require development time. We promise to provide a fully improved and stable experience in the next playtest to regain your trust.

Once again, I sincerely appreciate everyone who participated in the playtest and deeply apologize for any inconvenience caused. We remain fully committed to delivering a better gameplay experience and a more stable environment.

Additionally, as a token of appreciation for those who endured this testing phase with us, we are considering a special honorary reward for playtest participants when we launch Early Access.
We look forward to meeting you again in the next playtest with a more refined and enhanced experience.
Thank you from the bottom of my heart.
Sincerely,
Oneway Ticket Studio Development Team & Director Ray

notes.title: Director’s Message: Apology and Improvement Plan
notes.notes:
Hello, Survivors.

I sincerely apologize to all of you who are enduring a difficult time alongside the development team. Various issues have arisen so far, and we fully acknowledge the areas where we failed to make the game as solid as it should be. Despite the current lack of polish, we pushed forward with an open test because, for a small studio like ours, this process is essential.

Throughout this playtest we have discovered many potential issues, accurately identified necessary improvements, and have already determined necessary fixes. We are now not only preparing to fix server stability, but also many various game improvements.

That said, since it is impossible to fix everything during the testing period, we are reinforcing critical aspects with every server maintenance to lessen your frustrations as much as possible.

I sincerely wish that only my team and I could bear this difficult period, but as a Director, it pains me to know that survivors all over the world are also struggling with us. Honestly, I never expected The Midnight Walkers to receive this much attention, and I am truly grateful, yet at the same time, I feel deeply sorry and empathetic towards our players.

To those who are streaming the game and creating YouTube content, we have allowed full transparency from the early stages of development even without an NDA, guidelines, or rules about what can or can't be said. I'm very happy to give you the freedom to speak your thoughts openly and honestly. However, it remains true that currently our game is early and unstable. While we won’t restrict any content or streaming, we kindly ask for your understanding until the game reaches a more stable state and complete state. (We don’t want to disrupt your plans or those of your viewers.) 

From the very beginning, we have committed to transparency and open communication. We will continue to do so.

Once this playtest concludes, the team and I will do our best to restore the trust and good faith between the developers and players.

Thank you for being with us.

Director Ray.

notes.title: Reset of our Ranking data
notes.notes:
Dear Survivors,

First of all, we sincerely apologize for the unexpected inconvenience.
During recent server maintenance aimed at improving stability, an unexpected issue occurred that resulted in the unavoidable reset of our ranking system data.

Immediately following the incident, we explored numerous ways to restore the data. Multiple attempts were made, including reverting to previous ranking data or combining previous rankings with scores obtained after maintenance. Unfortunately, these solutions posed significant risks due to potential data conflicts with other systems, leading us to conclude that data recovery was not feasible. We deeply appreciate your understanding regarding this matter.

However, please rest assured that from this point forward, all scores earned will be properly recorded and reflected in the rankings. Our development team will be extra cautious to ensure such an incident does not happen again.

We will use this as an opportunity to enhance our service stability and provide you with a better gameplay experience.

Thank you once again for your patience and understanding.

notes.title: 1st Public Alpha Play Test Conclusion Time Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello, Survivors.
We would like to inform you of the public alpha play test end time.

[Public Alpha Play Test End Time]
- 2024/10/27 06:00 (UTC)

First of all, we would like to express our deepest gratitude to all of you who have been participating in The Midnight Walkers public alpha playtest. The time we’ve spent with you, our Survivors, during this journey has given us a new perspective on the game, and the passion and feedback you’ve shown us have become our most valuable assets.

Although this test is soon coming to an end, we believe that the conclusion of one journey marks the beginning of another. Your feedback is not just one voice; it is a lighthouse guiding us on the path we must follow. Even if the road ahead is difficult and steep at times, we believe that with you by our side, we can continue to push forward without tiring.

However, we sincerely apologize to everyone who experienced inconvenience due to frequent issues and server maintenance during the test. We encountered unexpected challenges, but we firmly believe that the lessons we learned through these experiences will serve as the foundation for a better game, just like how the sky becomes clearer after a storm.

Your feedback is not just a suggestion; it is a vital resource that will shape the future of The Midnight Walkers. The ideas and issue reports you shared have allowed us to grow and will be the driving force behind the improvements we will make in the future. We are committed to climbing the steep mountain ahead to ensure that when we meet again at the summit, we will all enjoy an even more thrilling experience.

Lastly, there is a saying I personally love: "When the clouds clear, the bright moon will appear." In the same way, we believe that by overcoming these difficult moments together, we will eventually create a fun and enjoyable game, where both the developers and the Survivors can bask in the bright light.

We extend our heartfelt gratitude to everyone who has been part of the community. The conversations, support, and feedback shared within the community were crucial to our growth. Thanks to you, we have been able to move forward, and we hope that we can continue this journey together.

We look forward to your continued interest and excitement for upcoming updates and news. We hope you continue to enjoy The Midnight Walkers for the remainder of the test period.

Thank you.
The Midnight Walkers Development Team

notes.title: Announcement of the play test start
notes.notes:
Hello, Survivors.

The first public playtest of [b]The Midnight Walkers[/b] has finally begun! We've worked hard to prepare for this moment, and it's truly meaningful to have you join us. Please note that this test is being conducted with [i][b]50% of the game's development[/b][/i] completed, so there may still be areas that need improvement. In particular, [b]character animations[/b] and [b]combat experience[/b] are still being refined, so you may find that they feel a bit raw. We appreciate your understanding as you take part in the test.

[h3]Server Optimization and Network Environment Notice[/h3]
In this test, [b]server optimization work[/b] is ongoing, and unexpected network delays may occur in certain sections. Depending on the network environment, there may be some discrepancies in hit detection, but we want to assure you that this will be addressed in the next test version. Playing in a [b]stable network environment[/b] will provide a smoother experience. Our team is working hard to fix these issues quickly, and we promise that [b]many improvements[/b] will be made in the next test version.

[h3]Your Feedback Helps Improve the Game[/h3]
We will continue to grow and develop based on your [b]feedback and suggestions[/b]. Please feel free to report any [b]bugs or areas that need improvement[/b] during your gameplay through the [url=https://discord.gg/themidnightwalkers]The Midnight Walkers Official Discord[/url]. We also welcome your [b]creative ideas and suggestions[/b] at any time. Your feedback, no matter how small, helps us make the game even better.

[h3]Building The Midnight Walkers Together[/h3]
This public test is not just a trial, but an important journey in which [b]we build The Midnight Walkers together with you[/b]. Every experience you have while surviving in this dark and intense world will be a key foundation for improving the game's completeness. Since the game is still under development, there may be some shortcomings, but our development team will work quickly to address and improve them.

Everything you experience and the feedback you provide during this test will be crucial in shaping the future of [b]The Midnight Walkers[/b]. We wish you the best of luck surviving in Liberty Grand Center, and we look forward to your feedback to help us create a better game.
Thank you.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2795540/The_Midnight_Walkers/

notes.title: Known issues during public testing
notes.notes:
Hello, Survivors.

We would like to inform you of the issues that have been identified in the first public test version of The Midnight Walkers. Please refer to the issues below to ensure smooth gameplay. Our development team is doing their best to resolve these issues, but we would greatly appreciate your participation in helping us solve them more quickly by reporting bugs and providing feedback on our [url=https://discord.gg/themidnightwalkers]official Discord[/url]. We are continuously working on improvements and bug fixes for the current game version. For more details, please refer to the following issues.

[h3]1. Character remaining in the results screen or another player's view after entering the escape pod[/h3]
- After entering the escape pod, the character may remain in the results screen or in the view of other players.

[h3]2. Awkward movements of zombie grab/bite/release during spectating[/h3]
- During spectating, the zombie’s grab or bite actions may appear unnatural.

[h3]3. No sound output at certain stairwell locations[/h3]
- Sound may not be output at specific stairwell locations. This issue only occurs in certain areas, and we are currently inspecting the related sound data.

[h3]4. Zombie corpses rendering abnormally during escape device activation[/h3]
- While the escape device is activated, nearby zombie corpses may render abnormally or appear displaced.

[h3]5. Zombie corpses penetrating terrain or bouncing after death[/h3]
- After a zombie dies, its corpse may penetrate the terrain or bounce off unnaturally.

[h3]6. Team member nickname continuously displayed during spectating[/h3]
- During spectating, the team member’s nickname may remain displayed on the screen.

[h3]7. Weapons remaining visible after character disconnects from the interval zone[/h3]
- If the game is exited from the interval zone, the character may disappear, but their weapon remains. This is a visual issue and will be fixed in a future update.

[h3]8. Tracker not displaying escape pod location or tracking status during spectating[/h3]
- When using the tracker during spectating, the escape pod’s location or tracking status may not be properly displayed. This issue only occurs in spectating mode and does not affect actual gameplay.

[h3]9. Zombies getting stuck between opened doors and terrain after interaction[/h3]
- After opening a door through interaction, zombies may become stuck between the door and the terrain.

[h3]10. Runner zombies partially clipping through doors[/h3]
- Runner zombies may partially clip through doors in certain situations.

[h3]11. Awkward zombie aggro reset in stairwells[/h3]
- Zombie aggro may reset awkwardly in stairwells, causing zombies to behave unexpectedly.

[h3]12. Terrain disappearing after character jumps and lands in specific locations[/h3]
- In certain locations, terrain may disappear temporarily when the character jumps and lands.

[h3]13. No release UI displayed during zombie grab[/h3]
- The release UI may not appear during a zombie's grab attack. Even if the UI is not displayed, pressing [F] repeatedly will allow you to escape.

[h3]14. Incorrect item count display during shop purchases[/h3]
- When purchasing items in the shop, the number of purchased items may be displayed incorrectly.

[h3]15. Zombie Synchronization Issue in Stairwells[/h3]
- There are instances where zombie aggro in stairwells behaves awkwardly and unintentionally. This may cause zombies to act in unexpected ways.

Your valuable feedback will be of great help in making The Midnight Walkers a more polished game. Please feel free to share any issues or suggestions on the [url=https://discord.gg/themidnightwalkers]official Discord[/url]. We will do our best to reflect your feedback and provide an improved game experience.

Thank you for your continued interest and participation.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2795540/The_Midnight_Walkers/
